# telnyx_sip_registration_status (Data Source)

The SIP registration status of a connection.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "telnyx_sip_registration_status" "web" {
  credential_type = "telephony_credential"
  connection_id   = telnyx_credential_connection.office.id
  username        = telnyx_telephony_credential.web.sip_username
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credential_type` (String) The credential type that was looked up. One of `sip_credential_connection`, `telephony_credential`, `uac_external_credential`.

### Optional

- `connection_id` (String) Identifier of the connection associated with the credential.
- `username` (String) SIP username to look up. Required when `credential_type` is `telephony_credential` or `sip_credential_connection`.

### Read-Only

- `connection_name` (String) Human-readable connection name.
- `credential_username` (String) SIP username used for the registration.
- `last_registration_response` (String) SIP response from the last registration attempt.
- `registered` (Boolean) True if the endpoint is currently registered.
- `sip_registration_details` (Attributes) Detailed registration information reported by the registrar. The populated fields depend on `credential_type`: UAC external credentials report `auth_retries`, `uptime`, `next_action_at`, `failures`, and `sip_uri_user_host`; telephony credentials and SIP credential connections report `ua_ip`, `ua_port`, `transport`, and `last_modified`. All types report `expires`, but its unit differs by `credential_type` — see that field. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sip_registration_details))
- `sip_registration_status` (String) Human-readable registration status derived from the registrar state.

<a id="nestedatt--sip_registration_details"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sip_registration_details`

Read-Only:

- `auth_retries` (Number) Number of authentication retries on the last attempt (uac_external_credential).
- `expires` (Number) When the current registration expires. The unit depends on `credential_type`: for `uac_external_credential` this is a Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch) of the next scheduled re-registration; for `telephony_credential` and `sip_credential_connection` this is the registration lifetime in seconds as negotiated with the registrar (the `Expires` value, defaulting to 3600 when the endpoint sends none).
- `failures` (Number) Count of consecutive registration failures (uac_external_credential).
- `last_modified` (String) Timestamp when the registration was last modified (telephony_credential and sip_credential_connection).
- `next_action_at` (Number) Unix timestamp of the next scheduled registration action (uac_external_credential).
- `sip_uri_user_host` (String) SIP URI user@host of the registered contact (uac_external_credential).
- `transport` (String) Transport used for the registration, e.g. UDP/TCP/TLS (telephony_credential and sip_credential_connection).
- `ua_ip` (String) IP address of the registered user agent (telephony_credential and sip_credential_connection).
- `ua_port` (Number) Port of the registered user agent (telephony_credential and sip_credential_connection).
- `uptime` (Number) Registration uptime reported by the registrar (uac_external_credential).
